name: lotroguides.com
description: Lord of the Rings Online fansite - Strapi CMS and Next.js frontend

scripts.prebuild: node scripts/vendor-giseldah-calcstat.js && node scripts/download-cdn-data.js && node scripts/link-public-assets.js
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix cms && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.heroku-postbuild: npm ci --prefix cms && npm ci --prefix web
scripts.update: npm run update:news && npm run update:loot && npm run update:skills && npm run update:maps && npm run update:lore && npm run update:icons && npm run update:videos && npm run import:lotro-data
scripts.deploy:functions: node scripts/vendor-giseldah-calcstat.js && node scripts/deploy-functions.js && node scripts/register-discord-commands.js && node scripts/deploy-functions.js discord && node scripts/deploy-functions.js collections
